verdict.reasons: Core product identity is not clearly the approved upright white-and-blue AFP drip-tape carton roll; the cylinder reads as white with a blue lower band and lacks clear tape-family recognition. The white band extending from the roll contradicts a black installed drip tape and suggests mixed/inconsistent product family. The installed laterals show a thick black hose-like appearance rather than flattened drip tape. The package is placed prominently beside active plumbing and functions as a visual proxy for the operating system, which is unsuitable as hardware. Minor advisory issues include framing and soil detail, but the core defects prevent acceptance.

acceptance_decision.source: user requested practical >=90 acceptance; actual saved vision evidence retained
